Here are the cells ready to add, after the existing facts cell:

> Verdict: "That matches what I see: the ports in your numbers are the dip."

**2. Hypothesis cell:**
> **Hypothesis.** The Q2 dip looks the same for every carrier type. Outcome: container, bulk and tanker each fell by about the same percentage from Q2 2023 to Q2 2024.

**3. View cell `dip_by_carrier_type`:** the same query as `dip_by_port`, grouped by `carrier_type`, with an added `pct_change` column.

> **Facts.** Container fell from 92 to 66 (−26, −28%), tanker from 23 to 13 (−10, −43%), and bulk from 44 to 36 (−8, −18%). Container holds 59% of the 44-shipment drop, tanker 23% and bulk 18%. Percentage changes range from −18% to −43%.
